states: Eight complete final-content cases: six final maintenance cases and two sufficient unchanged update cases. Desktop Chromium 141.0.7390.37/light and phone WebKit 26.0/dark; Playwright 1.56.1 matches the integration lock. Ten selected captures inspected. Not a fabricated single all-green run.

Held local one-off moves scheduled → active → expired at half-open boundaries without refetching or discarding policy/scheduler edits. Expected-offline, retired and never-auto-remediate controls persist.

Server-active occurrence is preserved as last reported after its own end passes, with current status explicitly unrefreshed. Neither monitoring resumption nor a new recurring occurrence is inferred. Inactive recurrence remains configured.

Successful global check ages 0s → 1 min → 2 mins without a new check, installation or verdict. Preview automatic-update lock and unsaved channel survive; source build withdraws check age and keeps Check Now unavailable.
No resource/API/schema/permission/action changes or native guest/backup/notification/updater, physical-phone, installed or publication acceptance.
interactions: Real controls use desktop mouse and phone touch. Edit the existing policy note and schedule reason, cross shared-clock boundaries, and remove the operator-state source; withdrawn evidence stays absent.
Preview selection uses the existing pressed button; locks and source-build availability checked. Real update store obtains one local synthetic GET check, then no further check or operation.

Real components, router, CSS, query/store and existing shared clock; page clocks advance while held synthetic inputs remain unchanged. Every selected case has no page errors, unspecified API, off-origin request or mutation; no horizontal overflow. Own contexts, browsers and Vite server closed. Host descendant cleanup is not independently reported.
